name: Narmada Agrobase Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2013, Narmada Agrobase Ltd manufactures and sells cotton seed and cattle feed[1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio[1][2]
Cotton Seed and Allied Products: Cottonseed Meal, Bleached Cotton Linters, Cotton Linters, Delinted Cotton Seed
Cattle Feed Products: Compound Cattle Feed (Pellet), Cattle Feed (Mesh) – Pashu Aahar
Value Added Products: Pelletized Cattle Feed, Molasses-Enriched Feed Blocks, Cottonseed Oil

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 8.43% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -16.2%
Working capital days have increased from 125 days to 195 days
